text:
Jordan: quick sync — Acme Health (HIPAA) wants a 2-week POC. Need decision on hosting: hosted vs dedicated vs private. also multi-region failover requirement. what do we recommend for initial scope?
Maya: short answer: start Dedicated in us-east-1 with canary to us-west-2. Private adds >2w infra lead time for their compliance team.
Ben: agree. Dedicated gives SLA + isolation they want without full on-prem. pricing wise we can do short-term reserved for POC to keep cost predictable.
Sasha: FYI security flagged they want an encrypted-in-transit AND at-rest proof plus KMS customer-managed keys. can Dedicated meet that?
Liam: yes — Dedicated supports CMK via our KMS integration. For Private we can provide HSM on prem but it's heavier.
Jordan: customer also asked for inference latency SLO: 150ms p95 for 512-token prompts. can we hit that on Dedicated with model selection?
Ben: depends on model. For gpt-like 13B we should be fine with continuous batching off and 2 reserved GPUs. for 70B need quant and more infra.
Maya: propose success criteria (short bullets):
- 1) Latency: p95 <= 150ms for our canonical 512-token prompt set (10k evals)
- 2) Quality: Rouge/F1 & curated prompt tests — no regression >5% vs baseline
- 3) Throughput: sustained 40 reqs/min with <10ms scheduling jitter
- 4) Security: CMK + audit logs + signed attestation from infra within POC window
- 5) Timeline: config + infra in 5 business days, run evals for 5 days, wrap + review on day 10
Jordan: buying team also sent security questionnaire — attached in case anyone needs to call out specific answers: https://redwood.internal/rfqs/acme-health-sq.pdf
sec-bot: automated: intake received by Security @ 1782450100. Assigned to Sasha.
Sasha: will answer HQ parts, but need input from runtime on kernel/quant options for the model family they want. Ben can you add likely recommended quant and perf notes?
Ben: recommendation: 13B float32 or q4_0 mixed -> Dedicated; use KV cache + prefix caching. if they want to push cost lower, q4_0 gets us ~2x tokens/sec improvement with small quality hit.
Jordan: customer cares about region residency — primary data must stay in us-east-1. failover allowed to us-west-2 only if encrypted and any PHI is scrubbed. that seems to push toward Dedicated in us-east for primary.
Maya: action items:
- Jordan: confirm POC acceptance criteria with buyer (today)
- Ben: provide a short perf matrix + quant tradeoffs doc (by EOD)
- Sasha: draft security questionnaire answers and list any open acceptance criteria (tomorrow)
- Liam: open dedicated capacity slot & region request (us-east-1) — estimate lead 48hrs
Jordan: rough pricing ask from buyer: cap POC spend to $12k. can Dedicated 2-week slot fit?
Ben: rough calc: 2 GPUs Reserved (p4x2 equiv) + infra + support = ~$9k-11k depending on model. looks doable.
Maya: include contingency for extra eval runs — we should propose $11.5k not to exceed $12k.
Sasha: blocker: they require SOC2 audit evidence for our dedicated offering in contract. we have SOC2 Type II report — will attach.
Jordan: perfect. I'll reply to buyer with Dedicated-first proposal + canary region and attach perf/SEC docs.
Liam: one more note on deployment config sample we plan to use for the POC:
```
deploy_mode: dedicated
region: us-east-1
failover_region: us-west-2
reserved_gpus: 2
model: redwood-13b-v2
kv_cache: true
cmk: customer-kms-id
```
Ben: that config matches perf guidance. we should add autoscale_min=2 autoscale_max=4 to handle bursts.
Maya: thanks everyone. Jordan ping me if buyer pushes Private — we'll need 2 additional days and security will route through their legal.
Jordan: sending email now. will post buyer reply here. :thumbsup:
